correctness.rationale: Direct commutator coefficients yield a truncated Wronskian with invertible index differences for characteristic p>n. Taking the first nonzero mismatched degree proves both exact commutant formulas, including the characteristic and midpoint boundaries; counting disjoint minimum-valuation strata proves the all-arity formula. Full native-product exhaustive tests verified five small-field cases for pairs, triples, individual centralizers, and Zinbiel identities.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical one-generated null-filiform Zinbiel algebra and the invariant is the complete count of pairwise commuting k-tuples, a natural extension of commuting probabilities. The valuation-dependent commutant classification supplies structural information beyond a small numerical census, the exact polynomial determines every finite-field arity, and the parity-dependent leading term identifies different maximal commuting dimensions/census behavior. This is not an immediate consequence of the prior maximum zero-product ideal dimension.
